# WeMagnifAI

> MagnifAI Growth Success Brand Magnifiers: An AI-driven agency platform offering dynamic campaign management, website insights, automated lead scraping (via Telegram/calculators), and agentic blogging engines.

## Key Resources
- [Insights / Blog](/insights) - Dynamic blog containing industry insights, growth strategies, and AI news.
- [Telegram Dashboard](/telegram-dashboard) - Operational console for configuring Telegram discovery and lead generation.
- [About Us](/about) - Overview of our mission and agency capabilities.

## Codebase Map for Agents
- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md) - Contains persistent project memories, stack definitions, and autonomous directives.
- [MARKETING_CONTEXT.md](/MARKETING_CONTEXT.md) - Enforces tone of voice, style guides, and brand rules for writing agents.
